commands.command: cargo clippy -p quansio-qworkerd -p quansio-machine -p quansio-server --all-targets -- -D warnings
ruff check, ruff format --check, mypy over python/intelligence
pytest python/tests  # 857 passed, 18 skipped (the live-provider suites, BLOCKED_EXTERNAL without credentials). New: test_model_gateway_pictures.py
git clone . && arch_check.py && pytest tests/architecture && validate_v81.py  # clean clone

QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev stack> cargo test --no-fail-fast -p quansio-machine -p quansio-qworkerd -p quansio-server  # 1361 passed, 0 failed. Real PostgreSQL, a real Unix socket, a real qworkerd, a real Chrome. New: worker_live.rs (pointer, chords, channel authorization, decision replay, ProvisionTarget roles/idempotence/concurrency, CancelRun), turn_loop.rs (autonomy modes through the turn loop), routines.rs (observing routines), policy::autonomy and identity::settings unit tests
cd apps/desktop && tsc --noEmit && eslint src tests

cd apps/desktop && vitest run  # 694 passed, 4 skipped (the recorder suites: the native recorder is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL, as before). New: worker-launcher.test.ts, worker-launcher.e2e.test.ts (real server, real daemon), live-input.test.ts, settings-form.test.ts, automation-triggers.test.ts

vitest run --config tests/e2e/vitest.config.ts --no-file-parallelism  # QA-008 on the built desktop, web bundle, real server, real worker and Chrome: 40 passed. New: live-worker.e2e.spec.ts (the viewer in a real Electron window: show, take over, click, right-click, double-click, drag, type, hand back). The stack now runs a real worker, which fixed approves-an-effect and the activity-indicator journeys that had no worker to run the effect

mutation checks: 22 mutants KILLED across the Rust, desktop and real-window suites; two (a worker target registered without the lock; anyone may register one) first SURVIVED the registration tests, which were strengthened (eight concurrent asks on a runtime with threads; a viewer and an editor refused) and then KILLED; every mutant compiles, every restored tree is identical, every control passes
